title: Your First Weekend at Ohio University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented on campus, finding an activity, and seeing a little of Athens.

cards.title: Start with a College Green walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Historic campus center
cards.notes: Use the Green as your first landmark: walk its paths, spot nearby academic buildings, and choose a return route to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A simple first orientation loop through the historic campus core.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies College Green as a featured stop on its campus tours and describes it as historic.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Baker
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Student-life hub
cards.notes: Stop at the information desk, locate the Center for Student Engagement & Leadership, and note the gallery, theatre, and meeting spaces for later.
cards.short_summary: A practical indoor stop for services, spaces, and campus-life information.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University calls Baker University Center the hub of student life and lists its information desk, theatre, galleries, and student-engagement office.
cards.access_notes: Public-facing building spaces and services vary by room and event.

cards.title: Choose one official weekend event
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Check the Athens listings
cards.notes: Open the official calendar, filter for Athens and your dates, then select one event with clear attendance details before you head out.
cards.short_summary: Use the university’s central calendar to make a specific plan.
cards.evidence_claim: The Calendar of University Events is Ohio University’s central calendar for official university and student-organization events.
cards.source_title: Calendar of University Events (CUE) | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the individual event’s time, location, audience, and any ticket or registration requirement.

cards.title: Make Alden your reset point
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 30 Park Place
cards.notes: Find the second-floor service desk and self-pickup shelf, then pick a floor that suits a quiet pause, reading, or planning session.
cards.short_summary: An academic anchor for a calm break and practical library orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists Alden Library at 30 Park Place and describes second-floor pickup and service-desk locations.
cards.source_title: Borrowing Books & Materials | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current hours; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.entity_name: Charles J. Ping Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Locate Ping for weekend recreation
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 82 South Green Drive
cards.notes: Walk by the recreation center, review its program offerings, and save the facility location for a future class, club, or intramural activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with multiple ways to participate later.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists the Charles J. Ping Recreation Center among Campus Recreation facilities; the university calendar gives its address as 82 South Green Drive.
cards.access_notes: Facility entry and program participation may have separate eligibility or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Browse the Saturday market
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Athens Community Center
cards.notes: Take a short off-campus outing to browse the market at your own pace; bring a reusable bag only if you plan to purchase something.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled Saturday-morning visit beyond the campus boundary.
cards.evidence_claim: Athens Farmers Market states that it operates Saturdays year-round from 9 a.m. to noon at the Athens Community Center, 701 East State Street.
cards.access_notes: Verify conditions before traveling; purchases are optional and sold by individual vendors.

cards.title: Ride the Purple Loop to connect the core
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Baker, College Green, South/East Green
cards.notes: Use the loop for a campus-scale orientation ride, then get off at a stop you have not yet explored and walk back deliberately.
cards.short_summary: A free campus transit loop linking central and green-space stops.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says the Purple Loop serves Baker University Center, College Green, and South/East Green; CATS daily campus shuttles are free and need no pass or ID.
cards.source_title: CATS Daily Campus Shuttles | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Runs Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. during fall and spring semesters; it does not run during breaks, holidays, or summer.

cards.title: Take a daylight walk at The Ridges
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Public trails and walkways
cards.notes: Choose a marked trail or walkway, check conditions, bring water, and keep the outing to daylight while you learn the area’s layout.
cards.short_summary: A daylight outdoor detour on Ohio University’s Athens campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that several hiking trails and walkways at The Ridges are available for public use, including Radar Hill.
cards.source_title: Visit The Ridges | Athens | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Use marked public trails and walkways; review the Ridges trail map and current conditions before leaving.

cards.title: Check for a public telescope night
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · The Ridges
cards.notes: If the calendar lists a clear-weather telescope night, arrive during the posted drop-in window and follow the parking and walking directions from the observatory.
cards.short_summary: A weather-dependent evening science activity at The Ridges.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says telescope nights at the Ohio University Observatory are free and open to the public, with viewing dependent on sky conditions.
cards.source_title: Public Telescope Nights at the Ohio University Observatory
cards.access_notes: Attend only on a posted telescope-night date; events are canceled when skies are cloudy or stormy.

cards.title: End by finding one way to get involved
cards.subtitle: Sunday · 330 Baker University Center
cards.notes: Browse Bobcat Connect or speak with staff about one student organization, program, or upcoming event that fits something you already enjoy.
cards.short_summary: A closing step that turns the weekend into one manageable next connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University’s Center for Student Engagement & Leadership supports student organizations and campus programming and directs students to Bobcat Connect for organizations and student-run events.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Engagement & Leadership | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Located at 330 Baker University Center; verify staff availability and individual event requirements.
